admission_process_records.detail: Admissions are open for the 2026-27 academic session.

admission_process_records.title: Choose program
admission_process_records.detail: Select the applicable IU Dehradun school and program: ICFAI Business School (IBS), ICFAI Tech School, ICFAI Law School, ICFAI Education School (IEdS), or ICFAI School of Pharmaceutical Sciences (ISPS).

admission_process_records.title: Online application
admission_process_records.detail: Use the official online registration / Apply Now link, pay the Rs. 500 online registration fee via card/net banking, and fill personal, academic and program-preference details.

admission_process_records.title: Submit documents
admission_process_records.detail: Upload a colour photograph and provide mark sheets/certificates and other documents requested by the admissions team.

admission_process_records.title: Selection process
admission_process_records.detail: Program-specific shortlisting may use qualifying marks, national entrance scores (JEE Main for B.Tech; CAT/MAT/XAT/CMAT/NMAT for MBA; CLAT/ILSAT for integrated law), or the university's own entrance evaluation, followed by a Personal Interview.

admission_process_records.title: Offer and enrollment
admission_process_records.detail: Selected candidates complete semester fee payment, document verification and enrollment as per the official admission communication.

10th and 12th mark sheets / certificates; graduation mark sheets and degree certificate for PG/PhD programs; entrance test scorecard if applicable (JEE Main / CAT / MAT / CLAT / GATE, etc.); passport size colour photograph (140-160 px, under 25KB, JPEG/GIF); government-issued ID proof; category certificate if applicable.
Selection process and eligibility vary by program. Applicants should verify the latest program-specific admission criteria on the official IU Dehradun website before applying.
